$runId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id','ts','driver','assistant','missionSeconds','penaltySeconds','totalSeconds','redLights']) && newData.child('driver').isString() && newData.child('driver').val().length <= 24 && newData.child('assistant').isString() && newData.child('assistant').val().length <= 24 && newData.child('totalSeconds').isNumber() && newData.child('totalSeconds').val() >= 0 && newData.child('totalSeconds').val() < 86400
